_about: Data for the combined station js/cook/stations/mishkaki-grill.js. `station`: its name, goal and one line per phase. `words` are the skewer kinds the order names (English placeholders until the family gives the Kutchi; ghos = meat is the draft word ph-meat). `mechanic.skewer` is shared by the thread and grill mechanics: which piece is meat or veg (`classes`), which word names which kind of skewer (`kinds`), and how each piece is drawn on a skewer (`art`, placeholder). `mechanic.levels`: which level each zone's mechanic runs at (the grill's own levels in data/cook.json add spots and speed) and `juggle`. Wave 6 (docs/UX-PRINCIPLES.md 5): one job at a time: thread every skewer, press "Go to the barbecue", then grill them. `juggle: true` (level 4, optional, for older children) is the old two-zone screen, threading while the grill cooks. The order's shape per level (1 skewer; 2; 2-3 with a mixed one; 3-4) is the mishkaki recipe's `skewers` slot.

station.name: Mishkaki grill
station.goal: Thread the skewers they asked for. Then go to the barbecue: turn each one on the green twice, and lift it onto the plate.

phases.thread: Tap the bowls to thread each skewer the way they said. Then tap "Go to the barbecue".
phases.grill: Tap a skewer on the rack to grill it. Turn it on the green twice, then lift it onto the plate.

ph-mixed._note: a skewer of meat and vegetables, threaded in the order said
